title: A value per day, week or month over the last periods, as bars or a line
about: Weekly distance run, monthly spending, sales per day, hours per week: one GROUP BY date_trunc query drawn as one bar per period, the periods with no rows shown as zero, with the total and the average per period as big numbers. The date column is a timestamp (created by default) or a 'YYYY-MM-DD' keyword.

date.about: the column with each row's day or time: a timestamp or a 'YYYY-MM-DD' keyword

value.about: the SQL aggregate per period: SUM(column), COUNT(*), AVG(column)

last.about: how many periods, ending with this one

format.about: how values read: number, money or hours

where.about: an SQL condition on the rows

line.about: true draws a line instead of bars

data.{{key}}: SELECT date_trunc('{{per}}', {{date}}) AS p, {{value}} AS v FROM {{table}}{{where|pre: WHERE }} GROUP BY date_trunc('{{per}}', {{date}}) ORDER BY p DESC LIMIT 500

let.{{key}}_periods: =(() => { const per = {{per|json}}; const n = Number({{last|json}}) || 12; const t = new Date(today + 'T00:00:00Z'); const out = []; if (per === 'month') { for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) out.push(new Date(Date.UTC(t.getUTCFullYear(), t.getUTCMonth() - i, 1)).toISOString().slice(0, 10)); } else { const step = per === 'week' ? 7 : 1; const start = per === 'week' ? t.getTime() - ((t.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7) * 864e5 : t.getTime(); for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) out.push(new Date(start - i * step * 864e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10)); } return out; })()
let.{{key}}_items: ={{key}}_periods.map(p => ({ label: new Date(p + 'T00:00:00Z').toLocaleDateString(undefined, {{per|json}} === 'month' ? { month: 'short', timeZone: 'UTC' } : { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' }), x: p, y: {{key}}_by[p] || 0, value: {{key}}_by[p] || 0 }))
